chunks.title: Research evidence review
chunks.body: Confirm telemetry freshness, required-channel coverage, operating state, and machine identity before interpreting equipment-health evidence. Do not treat research output as an instruction to stop equipment.

chunks.title: Wafer mount vacuum review
chunks.body: For abnormal vacuum evidence, inspect approved vacuum-path condition and sensor integrity under the site's reviewed maintenance procedure.

chunks.title: Wafer saw spindle review
chunks.body: For spindle evidence, compare current, speed, and available vibration observations. Inspect the spindle and cooling path only under the OEM and site safety procedure.

chunks.title: Die attach motion review
chunks.body: For Z-axis or placement evidence, review approved current, position-error, and settle-time channels before scheduling a manual inspection.

chunks.title: Wire bond head review
chunks.body: For bond-head evidence, review bond force and drive-current observations and follow the approved bond-head inspection procedure.

chunks.title: Molding hydraulic review
chunks.body: For hydraulic evidence, compare approved cavity and clamp pressure observations and follow lockout and site inspection procedures.

chunks.title: Laser marking optical review
chunks.body: For optical evidence, review delivered power against approved drive-current observations and use the site's laser-safety procedure.

chunks.title: Trim and form press review
chunks.body: For press evidence, review punch force, motor current, and available die observations before manual inspection.

chunks.title: Singulation spindle review
chunks.body: For spindle evidence, compare blade vibration, spindle current, and available speed and coolant observations using approved procedures.

chunks.title: Final test contact review
chunks.body: For contact evidence, review voltage-drop and current observations, then inspect the socket and contact system under the approved procedure.
